A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that it is possible to map code automatically on a heterogeneous intelligent memory architecture, which is an important step toward the development of a general compiler that can map applications on a wide range of intelligent memory systems.
we have designed an algorithm to automatically partition, schedule and assign code to processors and memory on an Intelligent memory architecture.
